provider.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access
requirements: museum object URL is retained only in sealed context

selectionRule: Object-level museum photography of a physical historical writing surface or inscribed object. The roster is fixed before image bytes are downloaded. This first physical gate prioritizes clearly inscribed surfaces that substantially fill the museum image; it is not an exhaustive or random sample of each tradition.
knownDesignLimits: All v3 witnesses come from one institutional imaging program, so institution cannot yet serve as an independent replication axis.
Writing system and physical medium are partly confounded in this roster; appearance-vs-substrate results therefore remain a physical-witness gate rather than a universal-culture claim.
The experiment does not use catalog transcription, translation, phonetic value, historical meaning, or sign identity during blind extraction.
A later writing-specificity control must compare inscribed regions with matched uninscribed surfaces before claiming that a structural effect is specific to writing rather than object texture.
